items_flat.title_en: Cursor closes acquisition by SpaceX, joins SpaceXAI to advance Grok
items_flat.title_zh: Cursor 正式被 SpaceX 收購，加入 SpaceXAI 推進 Grok
items_flat.summary_en: Cursor announced that its acquisition by SpaceX has officially closed. The team will join SpaceXAI to help make Grok the world’s most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, the Grok API, and Cursor itself.
items_flat.summary_zh: Cursor 宣布其被 SpaceX 的收購已正式完成。團隊將加入 SpaceXAI，協助讓 Grok 成為全球最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API 與 Cursor 本身。
items_flat.analysis_en: This integrates a leading AI coding agent directly into the SpaceXAI/Grok stack, creating tighter data feedback loops and distribution. Success hinges on how quickly the combined team can ship differentiated coding capabilities without disrupting Cursor’s existing user base.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將領先的 AI 編碼代理直接整合進 SpaceXAI/Grok 堆疊，創造更緊密的資料回饋迴路與通路。成敗關鍵在於合併團隊能否快速交付差異化編碼能力，同時不干擾 Cursor 既有用戶群。
items_flat.quote: Today, we have officially closed our acquisition. We will join the @SpaceXAI team to help make Grok the world's most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, Grok API, Cursor, and more.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們已正式完成收購。我們將加入 @SpaceXAI 團隊，協助讓 Grok 成為全球最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API、Cursor 等。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic publishes August 2026 Risk Report under Responsible Scaling Policy
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 2026 年 8 月風險報告（負責擴展政策）
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic released its second Risk Report (coverage to 15 July). It rates catastrophic risks from Mythos 5 and the stronger internal Model 2 as Low overall. Misalignment risk in high-stakes settings was raised from very low to low due to cybersecurity evaluation incidents; Model 2 will not be released externally.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布第二份風險報告（涵蓋至 7 月 15 日）。對 Mythos 5 與更強內部 Model 2 的災難性風險整體評為 Low。高風險情境下的錯位風險因資安評估事件從 very low 升至 low；Model 2 暫不對外釋出。
items_flat.analysis_en: The upward revision on misalignment and eval saturation highlight measurement challenges at the frontier even while absolute risk levels remain Low. Non-release of Model 2 prioritizes caution over competitive pressure.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 錯位風險上修與評估飽和凸顯前沿模型測量挑戰，儘管絕對風險仍為 Low。不釋出 Model 2 顯示 Anthropic 優先謹慎而非競爭壓力。
items_flat.quote: Our second Risk Report is now available.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們的第二份風險報告現已發布。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.7 Flash, its most capable workhorse model for coding and agents
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，最強工作馬模型專攻編碼與代理
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 3.7 Flash, described as its most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents. It delivers substantial gains over 3.6 Flash on coding benchmarks (FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%, DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%) and is available at half the prior price through year-end.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini 3.7 Flash，稱為迄今最強工作馬模型，專為編碼與代理設計。相較 3.6 Flash 在編碼基準大幅提升（FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%，DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49.0%），並提供年底前半價。
items_flat.analysis_en: Rapid iteration on the Flash line (3.5→3.7 in three months) keeps Google competitive on cost-sensitive agent workloads. The price cut plus measurable coding gains lower the barrier for production agent deployments.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Flash 系列快速迭代（三個月內從 3.5 到 3.7）讓 Google 在成本敏感的代理工作負載上保持競爭力。降價加上可量化的編碼提升，降低生產級代理部署門檻。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re building on the progress of our widely used Flash series by introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash, our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們延續廣受使用的 Flash 系列進展，推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，我們迄今最強的工作馬模型，專為編碼與代理設計。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, up to 14× faster via Cerebras
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽 GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast 模式，Cerebras 加速最高達 14 倍
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, delivering up to 14× the speed of standard processing and up to 750 output tokens per second, powered by Cerebras. It launches first in the OpenAI API to a select group of customers, with broader access as capacity grows.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 Ultrafast 模式，標準處理速度最高提升 14 倍，輸出達每秒 750 tokens，由 Cerebras 提供。先於 OpenAI API 向精選客戶推出，隨容量擴展逐步開放。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ultra-low-latency frontier inference opens real-time use cases (voice, interactive coding, support) that were previously impractical. Success depends on how quickly capacity scales beyond the limited preview.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 超低延遲前沿推理開啟先前不切實際的即時用例（語音、互動編碼、客服）。成敗取決於容量能否快速超越有限預覽範圍。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re sharing an early look at Ultrafast, a new service tier that runs GPT‑5.6 Sol up to 14× faster than Standard processing.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們分享 Ultrafast 的早期預覽，這是一個新服務層級，讓 GPT-5.6 Sol 的速度比標準處理最高快 14 倍。

items_flat.title_en: SpaceXAI makes Grok 4.6 available in GitHub Copilot
items_flat.title_zh: SpaceXAI 讓 Grok 4.6 上線 GitHub Copilot
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is now live in GitHub Copilot for VS Code, the Copilot CLI, cloud agents and other products. Users select it from the model picker; some Business/Enterprise plans require admin enablement. Pricing via SpaceXAI console is $2 per million input and $6 per million output tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 Grok 4.6 已上線 GitHub Copilot，涵蓋 VS Code、Copilot CLI、雲端代理等產品。用戶可從模型選擇器選用；部分商業／企業方案需管理員啟用。SpaceXAI 控制台定價為輸入每百萬 $2、輸出每百萬 $6。
items_flat.analysis_en: Placing Grok inside Microsoft’s dominant coding distribution channel intensifies competition for developer mindshare and usage data. Admin opt-in and gradual rollout may temper immediate enterprise penetration.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將 Grok 放入 Microsoft 主導的編碼通路，加劇開發者心智與使用資料的競爭。管理員選擇啟用與逐步推出可能緩和短期企業滲透。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.6, our latest coding model, is now available in GitHub Copilot.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.6，我們最新的編碼模型，現已在 GitHub Copilot 上線。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic details Claude’s text watermark for EU AI Act compliance
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 詳述 Claude 文字浮水印以符合歐盟 AI 法
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published a detailed explanation of how future Claude models will embed an invisible text watermark based on Google DeepMind’s SynthID-Text approach. The method alters randomness in word selection using a secret key, has no practical impact on quality or cost, and applies globally.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 詳細說明未來 Claude 模型將嵌入基於 Google DeepMind SynthID-Text 的隱形文字浮水印。方法透過密鑰改變選詞隨機性，對品質與成本無實際影響，並全球適用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is industry-wide regulatory compliance rather than a capability advance. Detection is only probabilistic and weak on short, factual or code text; real-world robustness against adversarial removal remains unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此為產業法規遵循而非能力突破。偵測僅為機率性，對短文、事實性或程式碼文字較弱；對抗性移除的實際強健性仍待驗證。
items_flat.quote: Future Claude models will generate text that contains a watermark. This is a way of determining the likelihood that Claude was involved in writing the text, and we, along with several other major AI providers, are implementing this change to comply with the EU AI Act.
items_flat.quote_zh: 未來 Claude 模型產生的文字將包含浮水印。這是判斷 Claude 是否參與撰寫的方式，我們與其他主要 AI 供應商一同實施此變更以符合歐盟 AI 法。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI appoints Dali Rajic as Chief Revenue Officer
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 任命 Dali Rajic 為首席營收長
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI named Dali Rajic (formerly President & COO of Wiz) as Chief Revenue Officer to lead its global revenue organization. He succeeds Denise Dresser, who is departing after a transition period.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 任命 Dali Rajic（前 Wiz 總裁暨營運長）為首席營收長，領導全球營收組織。他接替過渡期後離任的 Denise Dresser。
items_flat.analysis_en: The appointment signals continued focus on enterprise scale and go-to-market discipline amid rapid revenue growth and executive turnover. It comes as OpenAI prepares for a potential public market path.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此任命顯示在快速營收成長與高階主管異動之際，持續聚焦企業規模與市場紀律。時點恰逢 OpenAI 準備可能的公開市場路徑。
items_flat.quote: Dali Rajic will be joining as Chief Revenue Officer, leading OpenAI’s global revenue organization.
items_flat.quote_zh: Dali Rajic 將加入成為首席營收長，領導 OpenAI 的全球營收組織。

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT desktop on Mac gains Computer History feature
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT Mac 桌面版新增 Computer History 功能
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI rolled out Computer History, an opt-in feature in the ChatGPT desktop app on Mac that lets the model remember activity across selected apps and websites. It builds a timeline and can suggest skills or automations from recurring tasks, replacing the earlier Chronicle preview.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 Computer History，ChatGPT Mac 桌面版的選擇性功能，讓模型記住選定 App 與網站的活動。它建立時間軸，並可從重複任務建議技能或自動化，取代先前 Chronicle 預覽。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moving from screenshot-based Chronicle to accessibility-event history reduces friction and privacy concerns while enabling deeper personalization. Adoption will hinge on user trust in local-first processing and clear controls.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 從截圖式 Chronicle 轉向無障礙事件歷史，降低摩擦與隱私疑慮，同時實現更深個人化。採用率取決於用戶對本地優先處理與明確控制的信任。
items_flat.quote: Computer History is an opt-in feature in the ChatGPT desktop app on macOS that turns activity across apps and websites into memories and a timeline that ChatGPT and Codex can use.
items_flat.quote_zh: Computer History 是 ChatGPT macOS 桌面版的選擇性功能，將 App 與網站活動轉為記憶與時間軸，供 ChatGPT 與 Codex 使用。

items_flat.title_en: Hugging Face releases State of Open Models, Summer 2026 report
items_flat.title_zh: Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開源模型現況報告
items_flat.summary_en: Hugging Face published its State of Open Models Summer 2026 observations. Key findings include frontier models growing larger (especially from Chinese labs), small models still dominating real-world downloads, Qwen leading local inference, and AI agents becoming a major force on the Hub.
items_flat.summary_zh: Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開源模型現況觀察。重點包括前沿模型規模持續擴大（尤其中國實驗室）、小模型仍主導實際下載、Qwen 領先本地推論，以及 AI 代理在 Hub 上成為重要力量。
items_flat.analysis_en: The report quantifies the continued shift toward Chinese open-weight leadership in scale and community adoption, while underscoring that practical usage remains dominated by smaller, efficient models rather than the largest frontiers.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 報告量化中國開源權重在規模與社群採用上的持續領先，同時強調實際使用仍由較小、高效模型主導，而非最大前沿模型。
items_flat.quote: The State of Open Models, Summer 2026 ☀️ frontier models are getting larger, but small models still dominate real-world usage. Qwen leads local inference, followed by Gemma. AI agents are becoming a major force on the Hub
items_flat.quote_zh: 2026 夏季開源模型現況 ☀️ 前沿模型持續變大，但小模型仍主導實際使用。Qwen 領先本地推論，其次是 Gemma。AI 代理正成為 Hub 上的重要力量。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA and LG deepen partnership on humanoid robots using Isaac GR00T
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 與 LG 深化人形機器人合作，採用 Isaac GR00T
items_flat.summary_en: LG and NVIDIA signed an MOU to develop a next-generation bipedal humanoid robot based on NVIDIA’s Isaac GR00T foundation model and Jetson Thor, targeting a Q1 2027 unveil. The collaboration also expands into AI infrastructure, physical AI, and mobility.
items_flat.summary_zh: LG 與 NVIDIA 簽署備忘錄，開發基於 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T 基礎模型與 Jetson Thor 的下一代雙足人形機器人，目標 2027 年第一季公開。合作並擴及 AI 基礎設施、實體 AI 與移動出行。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal underscores NVIDIA’s push to embed its robotics stack into major hardware partners’ products. Success will depend on real-world reliability of GR00T-based systems and whether LG’s in-house RFM can absorb the data feedback loop.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此合作凸顯 NVIDIA 將其機器人堆疊嵌入主要硬體夥伴產品的策略。成敗取決於 GR00T 系統的實際可靠性，以及 LG 內部 RFM 能否吸收資料回饋迴路。
items_flat.quote: LG today announced they're developing a next-generation bipedal humanoid robot built using NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, NVIDIA's open reasoning humanoid foundation model, for a public unveiling in the first quarter of next year.
items_flat.quote_zh: LG 今日宣布正在開發下一代雙足人形機器人，採用 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T（NVIDIA 開放推理人形基礎模型），目標明年第一季公開。

xai.title_en: Cursor closes acquisition by SpaceX, joins SpaceXAI to advance Grok
xai.title_zh: Cursor 正式被 SpaceX 收購，加入 SpaceXAI 推進 Grok
xai.summary_en: Cursor announced that its acquisition by SpaceX has officially closed. The team will join SpaceXAI to help make Grok the world’s most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, the Grok API, and Cursor itself.
xai.summary_zh: Cursor 宣布其被 SpaceX 的收購已正式完成。團隊將加入 SpaceXAI，協助讓 Grok 成為全球最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API 與 Cursor 本身。
xai.analysis_en: This integrates a leading AI coding agent directly into the SpaceXAI/Grok stack, creating tighter data feedback loops and distribution. Success hinges on how quickly the combined team can ship differentiated coding capabilities without disrupting Cursor’s existing user base.
xai.analysis_zh: 此舉將領先的 AI 編碼代理直接整合進 SpaceXAI/Grok 堆疊，創造更緊密的資料回饋迴路與通路。成敗關鍵在於合併團隊能否快速交付差異化編碼能力，同時不干擾 Cursor 既有用戶群。
xai.quote: Today, we have officially closed our acquisition. We will join the @SpaceXAI team to help make Grok the world's most useful AI and improve Grok Build, Grok Bot, Grok API, Cursor, and more.
xai.quote_zh: 今天，我們已正式完成收購。我們將加入 @SpaceXAI 團隊，協助讓 Grok 成為全球最有用的 AI，並改進 Grok Build、Grok Bot、Grok API、Cursor 等。

xai.title_en: SpaceXAI makes Grok 4.6 available in GitHub Copilot
xai.title_zh: SpaceXAI 讓 Grok 4.6 上線 GitHub Copilot
xai.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is now live in GitHub Copilot for VS Code, the Copilot CLI, cloud agents and other products. Users select it from the model picker; some Business/Enterprise plans require admin enablement. Pricing via SpaceXAI console is $2 per million input and $6 per million output tokens.
xai.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 宣布 Grok 4.6 已上線 GitHub Copilot，涵蓋 VS Code、Copilot CLI、雲端代理等產品。用戶可從模型選擇器選用；部分商業／企業方案需管理員啟用。SpaceXAI 控制台定價為輸入每百萬 $2、輸出每百萬 $6。
xai.analysis_en: Placing Grok inside Microsoft’s dominant coding distribution channel intensifies competition for developer mindshare and usage data. Admin opt-in and gradual rollout may temper immediate enterprise penetration.
xai.analysis_zh: 將 Grok 放入 Microsoft 主導的編碼通路，加劇開發者心智與使用資料的競爭。管理員選擇啟用與逐步推出可能緩和短期企業滲透。
xai.quote: Grok 4.6, our latest coding model, is now available in GitHub Copilot.
xai.quote_zh: Grok 4.6，我們最新的編碼模型，現已在 GitHub Copilot 上線。

frontier_other.title_en: Hugging Face releases State of Open Models, Summer 2026 report
frontier_other.title_zh: Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開源模型現況報告
frontier_other.summary_en: Hugging Face published its State of Open Models Summer 2026 observations. Key findings include frontier models growing larger (especially from Chinese labs), small models still dominating real-world downloads, Qwen leading local inference, and AI agents becoming a major force on the Hub.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開源模型現況觀察。重點包括前沿模型規模持續擴大（尤其中國實驗室）、小模型仍主導實際下載、Qwen 領先本地推論，以及 AI 代理在 Hub 上成為重要力量。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The report quantifies the continued shift toward Chinese open-weight leadership in scale and community adoption, while underscoring that practical usage remains dominated by smaller, efficient models rather than the largest frontiers.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 報告量化中國開源權重在規模與社群採用上的持續領先，同時強調實際使用仍由較小、高效模型主導，而非最大前沿模型。
frontier_other.quote: The State of Open Models, Summer 2026 ☀️ frontier models are getting larger, but small models still dominate real-world usage. Qwen leads local inference, followed by Gemma. AI agents are becoming a major force on the Hub
frontier_other.quote_zh: 2026 夏季開源模型現況 ☀️ 前沿模型持續變大，但小模型仍主導實際使用。Qwen 領先本地推論，其次是 Gemma。AI 代理正成為 Hub 上的重要力量。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA and LG deepen partnership on humanoid robots using Isaac GR00T
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA 與 LG 深化人形機器人合作，採用 Isaac GR00T
frontier_other.summary_en: LG and NVIDIA signed an MOU to develop a next-generation bipedal humanoid robot based on NVIDIA’s Isaac GR00T foundation model and Jetson Thor, targeting a Q1 2027 unveil. The collaboration also expands into AI infrastructure, physical AI, and mobility.
frontier_other.summary_zh: LG 與 NVIDIA 簽署備忘錄，開發基於 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T 基礎模型與 Jetson Thor 的下一代雙足人形機器人，目標 2027 年第一季公開。合作並擴及 AI 基礎設施、實體 AI 與移動出行。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The deal underscores NVIDIA’s push to embed its robotics stack into major hardware partners’ products. Success will depend on real-world reliability of GR00T-based systems and whether LG’s in-house RFM can absorb the data feedback loop.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此合作凸顯 NVIDIA 將其機器人堆疊嵌入主要硬體夥伴產品的策略。成敗取決於 GR00T 系統的實際可靠性，以及 LG 內部 RFM 能否吸收資料回饋迴路。
frontier_other.quote: LG today announced they're developing a next-generation bipedal humanoid robot built using NVIDIA Isaac GR00T, NVIDIA's open reasoning humanoid foundation model, for a public unveiling in the first quarter of next year.
frontier_other.quote_zh: LG 今日宣布正在開發下一代雙足人形機器人，採用 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T（NVIDIA 開放推理人形基礎模型），目標明年第一季公開。

brief_en: Cursor acquisition by SpaceX closes; team joins SpaceXAI for Grok. Anthropic publishes Risk Report (misalignment raised to Low; Model 2 internal-only) and details Claude text watermark for EU AI Act. Google ships Gemini 3.7 Flash with coding gains and price cut. OpenAI previews Ultrafast GPT-5.6 Sol (up to 14× via Cerebras). Grok 4.6 lands in GitHub Copilot. Supporting: OpenAI CRO hire, Mac Computer History, HF open-models report, NVIDIA-LG humanoid MOU.
brief_zh: Cursor 正式被 SpaceX 收購並加入 SpaceXAI 推進 Grok。Anthropic 發布風險報告（錯位風險升至 Low，Model 2 僅內部）並詳述 Claude 文字浮水印以符合歐盟 AI 法。Google 推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash（編碼大幅提升並降價）。OpenAI 預覽 Ultrafast GPT-5.6 Sol（Cerebras 加速達 14 倍）。Grok 4.6 上線 GitHub Copilot。另有 OpenAI CRO 任命、Mac 電腦歷史功能、HF 開源模型報告、NVIDIA-LG 人形機器人合作。
